senses.gloss:
अर्ब् €1 P. (अर्बति, आनर्ब, अर्बितुम्)
—1 To go towards.
—2 To kill, hurt.
अर्बुकाः N. of a people; Mb.

अर्बु(र्ब)दः, -दम्
—1 A swelling, tumour, (of various kind); मांस˚, नासा˚, शोणित˚ &c.
—2 One hundred millions. बहूनीह सहस्राणि प्रयुतान्यर्बुदानि च । अशक्यान्येव
 संख्यातुं पन्नगानां तपोधन ॥ Mb. 1. 35. 19.
—3 N. of a mountain in the West of India (Abu).
—4 A serpent-like demon killed by Indra; Rv. 1. 51. 6.
—5 A serpent.
—6 A cloud.
—7 A place of pilgrimage (of the Jainas).
—8 A long round mass, lump of flesh; यदि पिण्डः पुमान् स्त्री चेत् पेशी
 नपुंसकं चेदर्बुदम् Suśr.; Y. 3. 75, 89 (मांसपिण्ड).
—9 N. of a people.
—10 N. of a hell.

अर्बु(र्ब)दः, -दम् + .{@-आकारः@} N. of the plant Cordia myxa^1 (Mar. गोंदणी, भोंकर).
[1] Correction submitted by Scott Rhodes on 20251211. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/102.

—1 A serpent-like demon conquered by Indra; Av. 11. 9 and 10 (in almost every verse).
—2 All-pervading lord.
अर्बुदिन् a. Afflicted with swelling or tumour,
